headline.en: Which weight you'll be billed for: volumetric or actual
headline.zh: 按体积重还是实重计费，一算就知道

sub.en: Enter box dimensions, actual weight and the mode. Get per-box volumetric weight, the chargeable weight per box and in total, and the freight bill including fuel — before the forwarder quotes you.
sub.zh: 输入箱子尺寸、实重和渠道，出每件体积重、单件和总计费重，以及含燃油的运费——货代报价之前先算清。

seo.title: Chargeable Weight Calculator — Volumetric vs Actual (Air & Express)
seo.desc: Calculate volumetric weight with divisor 5000, 6000 or 12000, compare against actual weight, get chargeable kg per box and total, and the freight bill with fuel surcharge.

outputs.expr: snap(max(actWt, volWt) * pcs, 0.5) * rate * (1 + fuel / 100) / snap(max(actWt, volWt) * pcs, 0.5)

showFormulas.expr: 长 × 宽 × 高 ÷ 除数
计费重 × 运价 × (1 + 燃油)

howTitle.zh: 航司卖的是舱位，不是公斤

howP.en: A 60×50×40 box holds 120 litres and weighs 8 kg. IATA's 6000 divisor says 120,000 cm³ ÷ 6000 = 20 kg — so you are billed for 20 kg and 12 of those kilograms are air. The divisor is the whole deal: express at 5000 charges 20% more than air on the identical box, and sea LCL at 12000 charges half. Compression is the cheapest freight upgrade that exists: one 10 cm height reduction on this box saves roughly ¥46 on air at ¥12/kg.
howP.zh: 一只 60×50×40 的箱子容积 120 升、实重 8kg。按 IATA 除数 6000：120000÷6000 = 20kg——你要为 20kg 付费，其中 12kg 是空气。除数就是全部秘密：同一只箱，快递按 5000 比空运贵 20%，海运拼箱按 12000 只要一半。压缩是最便宜的降本手段：这只箱高度压掉 10cm，空运按 12 元/kg 算一票就省 46 块。

q.en: Which divisor applies to my shipment?

a.en: International express (DHL/FedEx/UPS): 5000. General air freight and IATA standard: 6000 — some carriers still use 5000 on dense trade lanes, so check the quote. Sea LCL: 12000, and many consolidate at 1 m³ = 1000 kg. When in doubt, the forwarder's quote line 'chargeable weight' is legally binding, not their website's FAQ.
a.zh: 国际快递（DHL/FedEx/UPS）：5000。普通空运和 IATA 标准：6000——部分热门航线仍按 5000，以报价为准。海运拼箱：12000，很多航线按 1 立方 = 1000kg 收。有疑问时，货代报价单上的「计费重」一栏具有法律效力，官网 FAQ 说了不算。

q.en: Why does the total round to 0.5 kg?
q.zh: 为什么总计费重要取整到 0.5kg？

a.en: Most air waybills round the final chargeable weight up to the next 0.5 kg. Ten boxes at 19.7 kg each is 197 kg billed as 197.0, but 3 boxes at 19.75 kg would go to 59.5. On big shipments this rounding is noise; on small ones it can be 3–4% of the bill.
a.zh: 大多数空运单把最终计费重向上取到 0.5kg。10 件每件 19.7kg 合计 197kg 没影响，但 3 件每件 19.75 就会跳到 59.5。大票货这点取整是噪音，小票货能占到运费的 3–4%。

q.en: Can I bill some boxes on actual weight and some on volume?
q.zh: 能不能有的箱子按实重、有的按体积重？

a.en: No — the mode is applied per shipment, and within it per piece: each box takes the greater of its own actual and volumetric weight, then the sum is charged. A single dense box never subsidizes the light ones around it. That is why mixing dense and bulky items in one shipment needs its own calculation.
a.zh: 不能——计费方式按整票定，票内逐件取大：每只箱子各自比自己的实重和体积重，然后加总计费。重的箱子不会替旁边的轻箱子摊薄。所以轻重混装需要单独算，别指望拉平。

q.en: Is it cheaper to repack before shipping?
q.zh: 发货前重新打包划算吗？

a.en: Almost always, if volumetric wins. Removing 5 cm of box on each dimension of this example drops the chargeable weight by a quarter. Buy a tape measure before you buy a bigger freight budget — repack labour is minutes, the volumetric penalty is every shipment.
a.zh: 只要体积重说了算，几乎都划算。这个例子的箱子每个方向砍 5cm，计费重直接降四分之一。发货前先拿卷尺量箱子，比扩大运费预算便宜——重新打包是几分钟的事，体积重惩罚是每一票。

listing.long: Know which weight the invoice will use before the forwarder sends it. Compares actual vs volumetric for express, air and sea LCL divisors, with fuel surcharge included. Built for exporters and cross-border sellers tired of surprise freight bills.
bullets: Chargeable weight per box and per shipment
